characters.name: Halvor
characters.description: En ung mann som har sittet foran peisen og raket i asken hele livet, men som hogger hodene av tre troll og går til verdens ende for å finne Siri igjen.
characters.look: A tall, lanky young man of about twenty with a lazy slouch, a long face, a long straight nose, sleepy, half-closed hazel eyes, a slow lopsided smile and messy auburn hair falling over his forehead, with soot on his hands and cheeks. He wears a soot-streaked grey hoodie with holes at the elbows, baggy faded black joggers and battered grey trainers.

characters.name: Halvor i dress
characters.description: Halvor i dressen fra prinsessene, som sitter som om den var sydd til ham, og med ønskeringen fra Siri på fingeren.
characters.look: A tall, lanky young man of about twenty with a long face, a long straight nose, sleepy hazel eyes, a slow lopsided smile and messy auburn hair falling over his forehead, washed clean and wearing a perfectly tailored royal-blue suit, a crisp white shirt open at the collar, a lingonberry-red pocket square and polished black leather shoes.

characters.name: Den eldste prinsessa
characters.description: Den eldste av de tre prinsessene, som sitter ved rokken med tiara på hodet i det første slottet av glass og stål.
characters.look: A tall, stately young woman of about twenty-four with warm golden-brown skin, a long oval face, a straight nose, calm dark-brown eyes, neat arched eyebrows and thick black hair coiled into two round buns over her ears. She wears a small silver tiara, a long pale-blue dress with long sleeves and a high neck, and white trainers peeking out under the hem.

characters.name: Den mellomste prinsessa
characters.description: Den mellomste av de tre prinsessene, som har sittet så lenge i slottet med bassenget at mobilen hennes døde den første uka.
characters.look: A short, lively young woman of about twenty-one with warm golden-brown skin, a round face with dimpled cheeks, a small button nose, merry black eyes and glossy black hair cut in a thick, chin-length bob with a straight fringe. She wears a small gold tiara, a sunflower-yellow satin dress with a white cardigan over it, a string of big white pearls and white sandals.

characters.name: Siri av Soria Moria
characters.description: Den yngste av de tre prinsessene, som ser Halvor slåss mot trollet med ni hoder uten å skrike, og som gir ham en lunken ønskering med to regler.
characters.look: A graceful, slender young woman of about twenty with warm golden-brown skin, a heart-shaped face, a small straight nose, large, bright dark-brown eyes with long lashes, a calm, watchful gaze and long, straight, glossy black hair falling loose to her waist. She wears a thin gold tiara, a long-sleeved red knitted dress to the ankles, black ankle boots and a tiny gold sun pendant on a fine chain.

characters.name: Trollet med tre hoder
characters.description: Trollet i det første slottet, som suser gjennom korridorene så glassveggene synger, og stikker alle tre hodene inn gjennom døra.
characters.look: A big, pear-shaped troll about twice as tall as a man, with knobbly blue-grey skin like wet slate, long dangling arms and huge flat feet. He has exactly three heads side by side on his broad shoulders, each with a big round nose: the left head is sleepy, with droopy eyelids and a faded red beanie; the middle head is grumpy, with one bushy black eyebrow; the right head is surprised, with round eyes and a tuft of white hair. He wears a cracked brown leather jacket tied with rope.

characters.name: Trollet med seks hoder
characters.description: Trollet i slottet med bassenget, som er så stort og digert at det må gå sidelengs inn gjennom døra.
characters.look: A huge, barrel-shaped troll about three times as tall as a man, with pale sandstone-yellow skin covered in brown freckles and warts, and shoulders so wide that he must turn sideways to get through doors. He has exactly six heads in one long row along his shoulders, each with a long pointed nose, small beady eyes and a stiff tuft of black hair. He wears a huge patchwork coat stitched together from old tarpaulins and sacks, and goes barefoot.

characters.name: Trollet med ni hoder
characters.description: Det største og seigeste av de tre trollene, som vrir seg sidelengs inn i slottet av svart glass så karmen knaker.
characters.look: An enormous troll, the biggest of the three, about four times as tall as a man, with dark charcoal-grey skin, rough and lumpy like wet rock, a round belly and thick, stumpy legs. He has exactly nine small, round heads on short, thick necks, spread in a wide fan above his shoulders, each with a potato nose, bushy white eyebrows and a wide, frog-like mouth. He wears a ragged cloak of old sheepskins and a belt of knotted rope.

characters.name: Mora
characters.description: Halvors mor, som tror at den fremmede i dress er fra kommunen, helt til skinnet fra peisen faller på ansiktet hans.
characters.look: A small, sturdy, quick-moving woman of about sixty with a round chin, a wide mouth made for laughing, a little upturned nose, bright brown eyes and grey-streaked dark-brown hair tied up in a faded indigo scarf knotted on top of her head. She wears a heather-purple knitted jumper with rolled-up sleeves, a faded green apron, grey trousers and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Faren
characters.description: Halvors far, en stille mann som har limt den beste stolen i huset tre ganger, og som bukker for den fremmede i dress.
characters.look: A broad, slow-moving, heavy-set man of about sixty-five with a big round face, ruddy cheeks, a bulbous nose, a bushy salt-and-pepper beard and a bald head under a knitted blue beanie. He wears a worn moss-green fleece jacket over a checked flannel shirt, brown work trousers and heavy work boots.

characters.name: Kjerringa med den lange nesa
characters.description: Ei eldgammel kone i ei skakk hytte dypt inne i skogen, som spør månen og Vestavinden om veien og bytter til seg hesten, for bussen til kirka er lagt ned.
characters.look: A tall, bony, very old woman with a long thin neck, knobbly hands, a wrinkled, cheerful face, small twinkling black eyes and an enormously long, thin, pointed nose with a rosy tip, long enough to poke the embers with. Wisps of dove-grey hair peep out from under a white knitted hat. She wears a faded heather-blue fleece jumper, a long grey skirt, a black apron and green rubber boots.

characters.name: Vestavinden
characters.description: En travel vind som suser inn i hver krok av verden, er på vei til Soria Moria for å tørke tøy til bryllupet, og lar Halvor henge med så godt han kan.
characters.look: A wild, friendly wind spirit the size of a big man, with a round, rosy, beardless face, a wide merry grin and bright green eyes. His long streaming hair is made of whirling leaves and spruce needles, with three bright plastic clothes-pegs clipped in it, and an orange hi-vis vest flaps around his chest. From the waist down his body turns into long, curling swirls of misty grey-green air full of spinning leaves.

places.name: the Little House
places.look: A small, old white-painted wooden house with a crooked porch on a hillside in a coastal village, with a big farm further up the slope. Inside: a low living room with a sooty stone fireplace heaped with grey ash, a worn brown sofa, rag rugs on a scuffed wooden floor, a small kitchen through a doorway, and one wobbly wooden chair that has been glued three times.

places.name: the Glass Kitchen
places.look: The kitchen of the first troll castle, a building of glass and steel: bigger than a whole house and warm as a greenhouse, with tall glass walls lined with palms and ferns, a huge island of shiny steel in the middle, gold and silver pots and pans hanging on the walls, a polished concrete floor, and a wide doorway into a side room with an old wooden spinning wheel.

places.name: the Black Hall
places.look: The great hall of the third troll castle, built of black glass and dark stone that glitters where the light strikes it: a vast, high room with a polished dark stone floor, tall black-glass walls looking out on the dusk, a big open fireplace of dark stone, and one tall double door of black steel, barely wide enough for a troll.
